APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

12 oz handled mug

Backyard BBQ ↗

A 12 oz PS mug with a moulded handle: The handle keeps your hand off a hot wall when you are stood at the grill.

Outdoor Bars ↗

Stacks into the cabinet at close.

Camping & Outdoor ↗

The handle clips to a pack strap on the walk in.

Confirm for your project

Check table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions；service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；packed size, pack space and the temperature of hot drinks.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
